turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Aslam-alaikum, Mrs. Khan! How is your knee pain doing today?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Wa-alaikum-assalam, Zoya. It is a bit better, but the stairs are still difficult.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: You must take a break then. I am planning to visit Hyderabad next month for the festival.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Oh, that is wonderful news. Will you stay with us or at a hotel?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I will definitely stay with you! I can already smell the biryani.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I will make everything you like. But tell me, how is your work going?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Everything is fine. By the way, I sent twelve thousand rupees to your account for the house repairs.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: What? Why did you do that, beta? You should keep your money.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Do not worry about it, it is just a small gift for the home.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I will check the passbook tomorrow. You are too kind to me.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Just keep it safe for the painter. I will call you again on Sunday.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Alright, dear. Give my love to everyone there.
